# Router v7.18.0 open-by-bid error texts and how Uplink classifies them
# (internal/pool/transient.go classifyOpenErr). One case per line:
#   <class><TAB><postElapsed><TAB><error text>
# class: provider_fault | transient_presend | transient_window | wallet_funds |
# maybe_sent.
# postElapsed: how long the open POST ran. Every line assumes the operator
# set the router's RPC (ETH_NODE_ADDRESS) and the operation's 18 s-rule
# retry is unused; the other cases are in the tests. Texts follow the
# router's format strings (proxy-router v7.18.0) and the incident log,
# ids and hosts redacted.
